definitions.explanation: A village whose people live mainly by fishing, usually on a coast with a small harbor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{漁村|ぎょそん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: I visited a small fishing village.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{漁村|ぎょそん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{生|う}まれ{育|そだ}った。
examples.english: My grandfather was born and raised in a fishing village.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過疎化|かそか}→過疎化：05242_kasoka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}み→進む：01225_susumu⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{漁村|ぎょそん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{減|へ}っている→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: With depopulation, the number of young people in this fishing village falls every year.

notes:
A written word, common in geography, travel writing and the news.
